facts.fact: Adwave's Wavemaker turns the generated script into an AI storyboard using one of its 21 presets, according to Adwave's guide.
facts.quote: Next, Wavemaker turns the script into an AI storyboard using one of its 21 presets.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends keeping SOP and task training videos short at 30 to 90 seconds, with one task per video.
facts.quote: Keep short (30 to 90 seconds), one task per video

facts.fact: Adwave describes Wavemaker as its agentic video creator.
Wavemaker's vendor-stated typical turnaround is that most videos come back in about two to five minutes.
facts.quote: Most videos come back in about two to five minutes.

facts.fact: The article states that most effective training videos run two to eight minutes, and SOP clips run under two minutes.
facts.quote: Most effective training videos run two to eight minutes; SOP clips run under two.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits, which the vendor says is enough to create a first video.
facts.quote: Wavemaker's free plan gives you 75 credits, which is enough to create your first video

facts.fact: Videos made on Wavemaker's free plan export at 480p with a watermark.
Per the article, paid Wavemaker plans remove the watermark and offer higher resolution and more seats than the free plan.
facts.quote: upgrade for higher resolution, more seats, and no watermark

facts.fact: Wavemaker states that a custom AI voice can be designed to match brand tone on paid plans.
facts.quote: on paid plans you can design a custom voice to match your brand's tone

facts.fact: According to the article, each refine in Wavemaker's chat editing costs a small number of credits and takes a couple of minutes.
facts.quote: Each refine costs a small number of credits and takes a couple of minutes

facts.fact: The vendor says a small chat edit to update a training video costs only a few credits.
facts.quote: which costs only a few credits, so keeping a whole library current becomes an afternoon

facts.fact: The vendor says a refined edit costs only a small number of credits, so fixing one outdated step does not require rebuilding the whole video.
facts.quote: A refined edit costs only a small number of credits, so fixing a single outdated step doesn't mean rebuilding the whole video.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free tier does not require a credit card to create the first video.
facts.quote: Create your first video free with 75 credits, no credit card required.

facts.fact: Wavemaker runs an AI vision quality-control review on output before delivery to catch obvious issues.
facts.quote: Wavemaker runs an AI vision quality-control review, looking at the output to catch obvious issues.
